of.stand: The lemonade stand · Fig Jr.’s staff

nextWeek: Next: {title}, with {coins} coins for a full week.
nextTips: Next: {title}, with tips up to {cap} coins a day.

news.cafe: Bean has news for you. Talk to Bean to hear it.
news.stand: Fig Jr. has news for you. Talk to Fig Jr. to hear it.
news.condo: Spinner has news for you. Talk to Spinner to hear it.
news.store: Pip has news for you. Talk to Pip to hear it.
news.post: Stamp has news for you. Talk to Stamp to hear it.

promo.bean: Three turns of your last cup say {title}. The grounds never flatter.
promo.figjr: Review complete. Effective today, you are {title}. Division approves.
promo.spinner: Drumroll! Our newest {title} is you! The cabinets are applauding.
promo.pip: You are {title} now. It was the last one on the shelf, and it fits you.
promo.stamp: I weighed your work. It came to exactly {title}. Noted.

tipsCap: Tips stop at {cap} coins a day.
until: Calls stay open for the rest of the day.
shut: Closed today. The work waits until it opens.

word.cafe: Bean wants a word with you. Talk to Bean to hear it.
word.stand: Fig Jr. wants a word with you. Talk to Fig Jr. to hear it.
word.condo: Spinner wants a word with you. Talk to Spinner to hear it.
word.store: Pip wants a word with you. Talk to Pip to hear it.
word.post: Stamp wants a word with you. Talk to Stamp to hear it.

warn.bean: Last week’s cups read poorly. Another like it and you are {title} again.
warn.figjr: Performance concern noted. Another week like that returns you to {title}.
warn.spinner: The crowd went quiet! One more week like that and you are {title} again.
warn.pip: Last week was thin. Another like it and you are {title} again.
warn.stamp: Last week weighed light. Another like it and you are {title} again. Noted.

demoted.bean: The cups have spoken. You are {title} again; a better week wins the rank back.
demoted.figjr: Restructuring. Effective today, you are {title}. Upward remains open.
demoted.spinner: Not every show is a hit. You are {title} again; the stage is still yours.
demoted.pip: You are {title} again. Your old badge waits on the shelf until you earn it back.
demoted.stamp: I weighed the last two weeks. You are {title} again. Noted, not for ever.

warnCard: Another poor week here costs you a rank.

last.full: Last week was a full week: {xp} work XP extra.
last.poor: Under half last week’s work done: {xp} work XP taken back.

stand.big: Big glasses: a longer squeeze, and twice the tip.
stand.jug: The jug: fill it when nobody is waiting, and the next glasses skip the squeeze.

cafe.rush: A rush: customers one after another, and extra work XP for serving every one.
cafe.special: Special orders: a syrup step on top of some cups, and a better tip for them.
cafe.keys: Keys to the café: after a good shift you tidy the square nearest the café.

condo.streak: Gold cabinets: a perfect repair glows gold all day, and runs are counted.
condo.lamps: The square’s lamps: one you put right counts as a repair for Spinner.
condo.litter: The square’s litter: what you pick up out there counts as sweeping for Spinner.
condo.ghosts: The night shift: a ghost you catch on the square counts as a repair for Spinner.

store.basket: Baskets: some customers want two things at once.
store.deliver: Home delivery: Pip sends a parcel across the square to a resident’s door.
store.second: Two parcels on a delivery day, for two different doors across the square.
store.keys: The staff price: Pip’s shelf sells to you for less.

post.fifth: A fifth pigeonhole for Banana Town’s own post, and the cards come faster.
post.parcel: Parcels: sort them, then weigh them on the post office scale.
post.registered: Registered post: a red seal. Sorted at once it counts double; late, not at all.
post.round: The satchel: when a round of sorting counts, carry three letters to their doors.
post.bus: The morning post: the mail bus leaves a bag at the bus stop for you to bring in.

told.lamp: Spinner counts that lamp as one of your repairs.
told.litter: Spinner counts litter off the square as your sweeping.
told.tidy: You lock up and tidy the square by the café. The town looks better for it.
told.ghost: Spinner counts that ghost as one of your repairs.

ref.cafe: Fig Jr.’s reference counts: the Coffee Cup starts you at its second rank.
ref.condo: Bean’s reference counts: the arcade starts you at its second rank.
ref.store: Spinner’s reference counts: the store starts you at its second rank.
ref.post: Pip’s reference counts: the post office starts you at its second rank.

refCard.stand: Fig Jr.’s reference: the Coffee Cup would start you at its second rank.
refCard.cafe: Bean’s reference: the arcade would start you at its second rank.
refCard.condo: Spinner’s reference: the store would start you at its second rank.
refCard.store: Pip’s reference: the post office would start you at its second rank.

memento.stand: Fig Jr. gives you an apple crate for your homestead. It is in your shed.
memento.cafe: Bean gives you a coffee counter for your homestead. It is in your shed.
memento.condo: Spinner gives you an arcade cabinet for your homestead. It is in your shed.
memento.store: Pip gives you a display cabinet for your homestead. It is in your shed.
memento.post: Stamp gives you a grandfather clock for your homestead. It is in your shed.

mementoFull: Your boss has a gift for your homestead, but the shed is full. Make room.
